stories.title: Montrealers pay tribute to war veterans at annual Remembrance Day ceremony
stories.summary: Retired lieutenant-colonel Colin Robinson said Remembrance Day is an opportunity for Canadians to reflect on the dangers of war, particularly amid current global tensions.

stories.title: Quebec woman with ALS hears her own voice again thanks to AI app
stories.summary: A new AI tool is helping people with ALS regain a version of their voice, making conversations faster and more personal.

stories.title: Mark Kilam ‘where I’m supposed to be’ as Edmonton Elks head coach
stories.summary: Mark Kilam admits he's sentimental about his first Grey Cup as a head coach in a city he called home for 20 years — but it pales compared to his pride over Edmonton's resurgence.

stories.title: Pilot dead after Remembrance Day aircraft crashes in Quebec
stories.summary: Quebec provincial police said the crash happened at around 11 a.m. and there was only one person aboard the aircraft. The pilot was declared dead at the scene.

stories.title: Future of 66-year-old McMahon Stadium in the spotlight ahead of Grey Cup
stories.summary: The 66-year-old building will host the Canadian Football League's championship game Sunday between the Edmonton Elks and Montreal Alouettes.

stories.title: Call of the Wilde: Minnesota Wild edge the Montreal Canadiens in overtime
stories.summary: It was an evenly played game which is positive for Montreal as they establish themselves in the upper echelon. The final 2-1 Minnesota in overtime.

stories.title: Wealth gap between Montreal and Toronto remains steady, report finds
stories.summary: A new report has found that Quebec’s regions have closed the economic gap with Ontario, even as the wealth gap between Toronto and Montreal remains.

stories.title: Canadiens fans give Carey Price a hero’s welcome as goalie enters ring of honour
stories.summary: Price, 39, became the 62nd member of the Canadiens organization to enter the Hall of Fame, capping a remarkable journey that began in the remote community of Anahim Lake, B.C.

stories.title: 90-year-old veteran selling poppies says he was ‘harassed’ by Montreal metro security
stories.summary: 90-year-old Carl Andersen has been selling poppies in the Montreal metro since 2007, but he says he recently ran into a bit of an obstacle.

stories.title: Dresden keeps up Ontario landfill battle
stories.summary: A town is pushing back on the latest step to advance a controversial landfill and transfer station project, as Premier Doug Ford's government ramps up a search for garbage space.
